import parse

# Test left-aligned search with type and fill
r = parse.search('{:<}', 'hello       world')
print('Left-align search (no type):', r.fixed if r else None)

# Try with a specific type
r2 = parse.search('{w:<}', 'hello       world')
print('Left-align search (type w):', r2.fixed if r2 else None)

# What about just parsing?
r3 = parse.parse('{:<} world', 'hello       world')
print('Left-align parse:', r3.fixed if r3 else None)
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
